faq.q: What is Delta's current Official Community Plan?
faq.a: The Official Community Plan (Bylaw 8400, "Housing Our Future") was adopted by Delta Council on July 8, 2024. It's a single plan, and its Land Use Plan sets the designations for the whole city.

faq.q: How do I find what can be built on a Delta property?
faq.a: Check three things, in order: the property's designation in the Official Community Plan's Land Use Plan, its zone on the zoning maps (Zoning Bylaw 7600), and whether a development permit area applies. All three count.

faq.q: What did SSMUH change on Delta's single-family lots?
faq.a: Delta introduced the provincially required zoning updates allowing up to four units on all single-detached and duplex lots, as part of the framework the 2024 OCP provides for Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing.

faq.q: What does the Agriculture (A) designation mean?
faq.a: In the Official Community Plan, Agriculture (A) is the designation for farmland. Where the land is also in the Agricultural Land Reserve, the Agricultural Land Commission's rules on homes and uses apply on top of the City's agricultural zoning.
